## 1. The `uyvy_to_rgb565_scaled` Function (lines 3312-3365)

```c
static void uyvy_to_rgb565_scaled(const uint8_t *src,
                                  uint8_t *dst,
                                  int src_w, int src_h,
                                  int dst_w, int dst_h)
{
  int sx, sy, dx, dy;
  uint8_t *out = dst;
  int scale_x = src_w / dst_w;
  int scale_y = src_h / dst_h;

  for (dy = 0; dy < dst_h; dy++)
    {
      sy = dy * scale_y;
      const uint8_t *row = src + sy * src_w * 2;

      for (dx = 0; dx < dst_w; dx++)
        {
          uint8_t y0;
          int cb_i, cr_i, r, g, b;
          uint16_t rgb;
          int pos;

          sx = dx * scale_x;

          /* UYVY: pair pointer = start of 4-byte group */
          const uint8_t *p = row + (sx & ~1) * 2;

          y0   = p[1 + (sx & 1) * 2];     /* Y0=p[1], Y1=p[3] */
          cb_i = (int)p[0] - 128;          /* U  = byte0 */
          cr_i = (int)p[2] - 128;          /* V  = byte2 */

          r = (int)y0 + cr_i + (cr_i * 51 / 128);
          g = (int)y0 - (cb_i * 28 / 81) - (cr_i * 365 / 512);
          b = (int)y0 + cb_i + (cb_i * 99 / 128);

          if (r < 0) r = 0;  if (r > 255) r = 255;
          if (g < 0) g = 0;  if (g > 255) g = 255;
          if (b < 0) b = 0;  if (b > 255) b = 255;

          rgb = (uint16_t)(((r >> 3) << 11) | ((g >> 2) << 5) | (b >> 3));
          pos = (dy * dst_w + dx) * 2;
          out[pos]     = (uint8_t)(rgb >> 8);    /* big-endian hi byte first */
          out[pos + 1] = (uint8_t)(rgb & 0xff);
        }
    }
}
```

**Signature**: `static void uyvy_to_rgb565_scaled(const uint8_t *src, uint8_t *dst, int src_w, int src_h, int dst_w, int dst_h)`

**Key details**: Uses integer-only YUV-to-RGB conversion with fixed-point approximations. Output is big-endian RGB565 to match the LCD byte order. The scale factors are integer division (`src_w / dst_w`), so this is nearest-neighbor sampling.

## 2. DEBUG_JOURNAL "Preview Performance" Section (lines 3948-3977)

```
 * ========================================================================
 * Preview Performance (about 7 fps)
```

## 3. Existing Bench/Test Command Implementations

There are **no dedicated bench commands** in the camera file. The existing test commands are:

- **`camera id`** -- reads GC2145 chip ID via SCCB
- **`camera io`** -- DVP pin mux config/deconfig/readback
- **`camera init`** -- full GC2145 sensor init
- **`camera buf`** -- PSRAM framebuf alloc + test pattern verify
- **`camera sync`** -- DVP controller + VSYNC interrupt counting (closest to a bench -- times 5s timeout)
- **`camera grab`** -- single frame capture + hexdump
- **`camera stream [n]`** -- continuous capture with ping-pong, reports FPS
- **`camera preview [n] [panel]`** -- capture + LCD display, reports FPS
- **`camera dump`** -- capture + hexdump + 4-format YUV analysis
- **`camera testpat`** -- color bars to LCD (no camera)

The timing in `camera preview` uses `g_dvp_frame_count * 33` (estimated from 30fps sensor rate), not a real clock. The stream command also uses this estimated timing.

---

## 4. Command Registration Mechanism

Commands are registered as **NuttX builtin apps** via the standard pattern:

**Kconfig** (`app/camera/Kconfig`):
```
config EXAMPLES_GC2145_ID
    tristate "GC2145 camera ID test command"
    default n

config EXAMPLES_GC2145_ID_PROGNAME
    string "Program name"
    default "camera"        <-- this becomes the NSH command name

config EXAMPLES_GC2145_ID_PRIORITY
    int "Task priority"
    default 100

config EXAMPLES_GC2145_ID_STACKSIZE
    int "Stack size"
    default DEFAULT_TASK_STACKSIZE
```

**CMakeLists.txt** (`app/camera/CMakeLists.txt`):
```cmake
nuttx_add_application(
    MODULE ${CONFIG_EXAMPLES_GC2145_ID}
    NAME ${CONFIG_EXAMPLES_GC2145_ID_PROGNAME}    # "camera"
    SRCS camera_main.c
    STACKSIZE ${CONFIG_EXAMPLES_GC2145_ID_STACKSIZE}
    PRIORITY ${CONFIG_EXAMPLES_GC2145_ID_PRIORITY})
```

**Makefile** (`app/camera/Makefile`):
```makefile
PROGNAME  = $(CONFIG_EXAMPLES_GC2145_ID_PROGNAME)
PRIORITY  = $(CONFIG_EXAMPLES_GC2145_ID_PRIORITY)
STACKSIZE = $(CONFIG_EXAMPLES_GC2145_ID_STACKSIZE)
```

The `camera_main.c` entry point is a standard `int main(int argc, char *argv[])` that dispatches subcommands via `strcmp(argv[1], ...)`.

The lcdtest uses the same pattern -- `bk7258_lcdtest_main()` is declared extern in `app/lcdtest/lcdtest_main.c` and called from its `main()`. It also dispatches subcommands via `strcmp`.

**Key architecture decision** (from DEBUG_JOURNAL section 22.10): LCD frame buffers stay in SRAM (high-frequency refresh, 200KB fits in 336KB SRAM).
